sources.title: The effects of foam rolling on ankle dorsiflexion range of motion in healthy adults: A systematic literature review
sources.journal: Journal of Bodywork and Movement Therapies
sources.notes: Justifies foam rolling as a warm-up or alternative for users who experience muscle tightness without altering tissue strength.

sources.title: Effect of Joint Mobilization in Individuals with Chronic Ankle Instability: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
sources.notes: Justifies manual glides when joint stiffness is present for restoring dorsiflexion.

sources.title: The association of ankle dorsiflexion and dynamic knee valgus: A systematic review and meta-analysis
sources.notes: Explains why fixing a 5° ankle limitation matters—preventing knee collapse and lower-limb injury during dynamic movements (squats, jumps).

sources.title: Chronic effect of different types of stretching on ankle dorsiflexion range of motion_ Systematic review and meta-analysis
sources.notes: Quantifies exact degree gains (+5.17° for static stretching) and instructs the LLM to recommend static/PNF over ballistic stretching.

sources.title: Interventions for increasing ankle joint dorsiflexion: a systematic review and meta‐analysis
sources.notes: Establishes clinical cutoffs for ankle restriction (<10° equinus) and validates combination protocols (e.g., heat/stretching).
